instructions:
## Research objective

Design a replay-memory method that improves sample efficiency and limits overfitting when the agent repeatedly learns from a limited experience buffer.

## Work to perform

Evaluate within the supplied continuous-control setups. Source tables cover DeepMind Control with state and pixel observations, plus Walker2d, HalfCheetah and Hopper. Compare to supplied replay and model-based baselines using the same interaction budget.

Start from the supplied baseline repository, formulate an improvement, implement it, execute the experiments, and use observed results to refine the method. The benchmark withholds the original paper’s proposed solution.

## Deliverable

Working replay/training method and evaluation outputs in the provided environment.

## Evaluation

Average episodic return under the task’s environment and interaction budgets. Compare against the baseline values in the linked task brief. Evaluation datasets/conditions are component subtasks of this research environment, not separately provisioned workspaces.

## Resources

ResearchGym reports autonomous 12–24-hour runs and fixed API budgets. The README default API budget is $10; exact GPU model is not specified in this task brief.

This is a paraphrased reading guide. [Read the complete task instructions and baseline tables](https://github.com/Anikethh/ResearchGym/blob/main/tasks/test/improving-replay-buffers/task_description.md).
